description: Sales of Oil & Gas Products by Product is a dataset listed in Artificial Intelligence Global Company - ODS open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Authority. This dataset contains United Arab Emirates Sales of Oil & Gas Products by Product for- 2009-2020. Data from Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Authority. Follow datasource.kapsarc.org for timely data to advance energy economics research. Coverage: Gulf Cooperation Council states. The portal files it under Oil & gas. Its keywords are Kerosene, Butane, Propane, Methane, Diesel, Oil. The portal shows 507 records. The portal shows 2025-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-aigc-portal.
